defect.symptom: cw.py task supersede T-1788671453544-d0625554 T-1788673904079-5fa6fb84 failed with E_WORKSPACE_AUTHORITY_MISMATCH (binding ws-1 vs request ws-10)
defect.root_cause: route_task_write/route_task_read (server/daemon_client.py) unconditionally call _inject_workspace_id, which resolves the legacy ACTIVE workspace (ws-10 on the shared multi-project daemon) instead of the immutable task_workspace_bindings row (ws-1). _is_task_scoped_authority_request only recognized task_id, while task.supersede carries superseded_id/superseding_id and task.superseded_by historically superseded_id, so the supersede family never hit the task-scoped skip in route_rpc and the wrong numeric workspace reached the daemon.
impact: task.supersede: daemon fail-closed E_WORKSPACE_AUTHORITY_MISMATCH (governance mutation blocked)
task.superseded_by: silent wrong-workspace filtered projection (relations invisible)

changes: _is_task_scoped_authority_request: recognize non-blank superseded_id alongside task_id (task_id behavior unchanged)
route_task_write: skip _inject_workspace_id for TASK_SUPERSEDE_ROUTE_POLICY methods when the request is task-scoped
route_task_read: same conditional skip with SR-01 rationale
explicitly supplied workspace_id is forwarded untouched (daemon fails closed on binding mismatch)
fix.authority_model: daemon resolves an omitted numeric workspace_id from the immutable task_workspace_bindings and rejects an explicit mismatch (task_bound_workspace_id, fail-closed); client no longer preempts with the legacy active workspace
